title: Explore collection value-earned score
description: Design and validate a retroactive money's-worth feature for collection games. Add purchase price as required data, then calculate a quality-adjusted social-hour value using fitness score, typical player count, play time, and number of plays. Proposed model: lifetime value = plays * playtime_hours * (fitness/max_fitness) * sqrt(player_count) * target_hourly_value; value-earned ratio = lifetime value / purchase_price. Decide configurable defaults and UI/reporting for break-even status and effective cost per quality-adjusted social hour.
